Definition: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
BiblicalUsage: Yâtsab means to stand firm, to take a place and hold it. The mighty men set themselves in the midst of the parcel of ground and delivered it, and the LORD came and stood and called Samuel as at other times.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God stands with those who stand, and the boy who answers is the man who will lead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
